meta.rca_note: Current TrainAudit runtime emits rule_id + rule_message only. Multi-hop RCA agent drill-down was not stored per-case; rca_chain left empty across the board. L2 verdict therefore N/A for all 17 records (cf. SPEC §8 Multi-rule fire + Known Failure Modes 'RCA chain missing').

cases.rule_message: 1 replica params diverged across replica group
cases.ground_truth_title: SwitchMLP router torch.nn.Linear init not wrapped in data-parallel RNG tracker
cases.ground_truth_summary: SwitchMLP router init does torch.nn.Linear(...) outside any RNG tracker fork; if default CUDA RNG state is asymmetric across TP ranks at construction, router weights diverge. Fix wraps init in get_cuda_rng_tracker().fork(get_data_parallel_rng_tracker_name()).
cases.ground_truth_invariant: During SwitchMLP construction, router weight init must execute inside a get_cuda_rng_tracker().fork(<data-parallel name>) context; equivalently, after init the router weights should be replicated (equal) across the appropriate replica group.

cases.rule_message: 1 replica params' gradients diverged across replica group (B2-style backward all-reduce miss)
cases.ground_truth_title: LinearWithFrozenWeight backward forgets to all-reduce grad_input across TP
cases.ground_truth_summary: LinearWithFrozenWeight.backward returns grad_input without all-reducing across TP ranks; each rank only sees its column-shard, so the upstream gradient is wrong by a factor of N (TP size).
cases.ground_truth_invariant: After backward of linear_with_frozen_weight on TP=N, grad_input must equal the sum across the N TP ranks (i.e., post-allreduce replicated value).

cases.rule_message: 1 comm op(s) used dtype != declared training_dtype (bfloat16)
cases.ground_truth_title: DeepSpeedEngine.communication_data_type defaults to fp32 when only bfloat16 is enabled
cases.ground_truth_summary: DeepSpeedEngine.communication_data_type returned torch.float32 when bf16_enabled but no explicit comm dtype, so allreduce/reduce ran in fp32 silently breaking the bf16 contract. Fix returns torch.bfloat16 when bfloat16_enabled.
cases.ground_truth_invariant: engine.communication_data_type() must be torch.bfloat16 when only bf16 is enabled; equivalently, comm op dtype must match the declared training dtype.

cases.rule_message: 1 parallelism group(s) have wrong size (declared != actual)
cases.ground_truth_title: InferenceEngine creates EP groups with num_experts instead of ep_size
cases.ground_truth_summary: InferenceEngine.__init__ called self._create_ep_parallel_group(config.moe.moe_experts) — should be (config.moe.ep_size). EP group ends up with wrong size; when num_experts > world_size, construction fails or creates malformed groups.
cases.ground_truth_invariant: Each parallelism group (EP/DP/TP) must have size equal to its declared configuration value; here EP group size must equal ep_size, not num_experts.

cases.rule_message: 1 clip_grad calls left grad norm > max_norm
cases.ground_truth_title: clip_grad_norm_ uses torch.max instead of torch.min for clip_coef
cases.ground_truth_summary: deepspeed/runtime/utils.py:clip_grad_norm_ used torch.max(1, max_norm/total_norm) so clip_coef=1 when grads exceed threshold (no clipping). Fix changes max -> min so clip_coef <= 1 properly clips.
cases.ground_truth_invariant: After clip_grad_norm_, ||grad|| must be <= max_norm (within tolerance).

cases.ground_truth_title: AdamWConfig.build does not set initial_lr on param_groups; restart-time peak LR lost
cases.ground_truth_summary: AdamWConfig.build() returned torch.optim.AdamW without setting initial_lr on each param_group. PyTorch LRScheduler with last_epoch>=0 requires initial_lr; without it, peak LR after restart is lost.
cases.ground_truth_invariant: After AdamWConfig.build(model), every param_group must contain the key 'initial_lr'.

cases.rule_message: 1/1 residual blocks: output closer to normed than to original input
cases.ground_truth_summary: OLMoSequentialBlock.forward did `x = self.attn_norm(x)` clobbering the residual stream so the identity path uses the normed x instead of the original input.
cases.ground_truth_invariant: After calling self.attn_norm, the residual variable x must equal the original input (not the normed version); i.e., residual stream must be preserved across the norm.

cases.ground_truth_title: TopKRouter expert_bias gets wrong dtype (bf16 instead of fp32)
cases.ground_truth_summary: Float16Module converts all registered buffers to bf16/fp16. expert_bias is a fp32 buffer that gets silently downcast, causing precision loss in routing decisions.
cases.ground_truth_invariant: expert_bias.dtype must be torch.float32 during routing; bf16/fp16 = bug.

cases.ground_truth_title: MoE Router topk=1 with post-softmax gives trivial probabilities and zero gradient
cases.ground_truth_summary: topk-then-softmax with k=1: softmax over a single value is always 1.0, producing zero gradient for the router. Router weights never learn.
cases.ground_truth_invariant: Router routing probabilities must have non-trivial distribution; all probs == 1.0 (degenerate one-hot) means zero gradient = bug.

cases.rule_message: layer count mismatch: actual 20 (per-rank 4 × pp_size 5) != declared 24
cases.ground_truth_title: Pipeline parallel silently trains with fewer layers than configured
cases.ground_truth_summary: Integer division (num_layers // pp_size) silently drops layers when not evenly divisible. No assertion existed outside the virtual pipeline block, so training proceeds with fewer layers than configured.
cases.ground_truth_invariant: Actual total transformer layers across all PP ranks must equal the configured num_layers.

cases.ground_truth_title: Router input jitter dtype bug — silent fp32 promotion
cases.ground_truth_summary: torch.distributions.uniform.Uniform creates fp32 tensors by default. Multiplying bf16 input by fp32 jitter silently promotes the result to fp32, breaking the bf16 dtype contract for router input.
cases.ground_truth_invariant: apply_input_jitter output dtype must equal input dtype; dtype promotion from bf16 to fp32 = bug.

cases.ground_truth_title: MoE aux loss not scaled by num_tokens in per_token_loss mode
cases.ground_truth_summary: When the router is configured for per-token loss mode, the MoE aux loss is missing the /num_tokens scaling factor; the router module lacks the calculate_per_token_loss attribute that the loss-scaling path expects.
cases.ground_truth_invariant: In per-token loss mode, every router module must expose a calculate_per_token_loss attribute so the aux loss is correctly normalized by num_tokens.

cases.rule_message: 1 checkpoint calls used preserve_rng_state=False while dropout is present
cases.ground_truth_title: preserve_rng_state incorrectly set to False with dropout
cases.ground_truth_summary: Boolean condition is inverted: preserve_rng_state = (all_dropout == 0) instead of not(all_dropout == 0). With dropout active, activation checkpointing then re-runs forward with a different RNG state, corrupting gradients.
cases.ground_truth_invariant: When dropout > 0 is present in a block, activation checkpointing must use preserve_rng_state=True.

cases.ground_truth_title: RMSNorm uses L2 norm instead of root-mean-square — wrong normalization
cases.ground_truth_summary: x.norm(2) is L2 norm sqrt(sum(x^2)), not RMS sqrt(mean(x^2)). The normalizer divides by L2 instead of RMS, so output magnitude is wrong by a factor of sqrt(d).
cases.ground_truth_invariant: After RMSNorm, output.pow(2).mean(-1) should be approximately 1.0 (unit RMS).

cases.ground_truth_title: Token IDs silently truncated to 16-bit by modulo 2^16
cases.ground_truth_summary: Token IDs from the dataloader are silently truncated to 16-bit by an implicit modulo 2^16, so IDs beyond uint16 range wrap around. The model then trains/embedding-lookups on the wrong tokens.
cases.ground_truth_invariant: Every token id emitted by the dataloader must lie in [0, vocab_size); out-of-range ids = bug.

cases.rule_message: optim state['step'] failed to increment in 3/3 transitions
cases.ground_truth_title: Adam step counter not incremented — bias correction permanently wrong
cases.ground_truth_summary: step.add_(step_factor) was commented out in adamw_step, so optimizer state 'step' never increments. Adam bias-correction term therefore stays at step=0 forever.
cases.ground_truth_invariant: Optimizer state 'step' must strictly increment by 1 at every optimizer.step() call.

cases.rule_message: sqrt decay shape inverted: end-of-training |slope|=3.2000 >> start-of-training |slope|=0.0000
cases.ground_truth_title: sqrt decay LR schedule uses wrong formula — decay curve inverted
cases.ground_truth_summary: sqrt decay scheduler uses sqrt(progress) instead of 1-sqrt(1-progress); the decay curve shape is inverted (flat at start, steep at end) rather than the intended front-loaded fast decay.
cases.ground_truth_invariant: sqrt decay LR must decay fast initially and slow at the end (|slope| at start >> |slope| at end).
